moa: non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (doravirine) with two nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (lamivudine, tenofovir disoproxil fumarate)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 210807 ... DELSTRIGO (doravirine, lamivudine, and tenofovir disoproxil fumarate) tablets as a complete regimen for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in adult patients with no antiretroviral treatment history (FDA approval letter, signed 08/30/2018)

series_start_reason: Merck prints Delstrigo on its own sales line only from the first-quarter 2024 earnings release and Form 10-Q, which carry the four 2023 quarters as prior-year columns, so the series starts at 2023Q1. Merck's releases and 10-Qs through the fourth-quarter 2023 print no Delstrigo sales, and the FY2023 10-K does not either. The FY2024 10-K prints annual Delstrigo sales 2022 of 151, which cannot be split into quarters; 2018-2021 annual figures were not found in a Merck sales table.
notes: Worldwide (U.S. plus international) Delstrigo sales in USD millions from Merck's product sales table, which the 10-Q/10-K tables split into U.S. and international columns. Pifeltro (doravirine alone) is a separate line and is not included. 2023 quarters come from prior-year columns of the 2024 releases (2023Q1 from the Q1 2024 release, and so on). Quarters sum to the printed year within rounding of 1 (2023 202 vs 201, 2024 250 vs 249); 2025 equals the printed 306.
